code_block:
resource "aws_security_group" "ssm_sg" {
  name        = "ssm-security-group"
  description = "Security group for SSM managed instances"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id

  # Allow HTTPS egress for SSM communication
  egress {
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
    description = "Allow HTTPS outbound traffic for SSM"
  }

  # Allow HTTP egress (required for Alma Linux to update packages)
  egress {
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
    description = "Allow HTTP outbound traffic"
  }
}
